scientific_integrity: Proof and new local invariant formulas checked from the package; no external independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All formulas classify torus-fixed points only, not the entire non-Q-Gorenstein or singular locus.
The universal proof uses established edge-polytope facet/normality results.
Finite checks for n=4..11 corroborate but do not prove the all-parameter result.
An equivalent unindexed specialization of wheel edge toric geometry remains possible.
title: Padovan local class groups and exceptional Gorenstein charts for wheel edge-toric varieties
